entwurf.thema: Using Qlib's RD‑Agent for Factor Mining
entwurf.beschreibung: A concise guide showing how a quant researcher can use Microsoft Qlib's open‑source RD‑Agent to automate factor discovery, step by step, while noting current limitations.

teile.name: Hook
teile.text: Struggling to find reliable alpha factors? Qlib's RD‑Agent automates the hunt, saving hours of manual work.
teile.szene: A frustrated quant sits amid stacks of spreadsheets, sighs, then clicks a terminal window where RD‑Agent begins scanning data, neon city‑scape background, soft side‑light.

teile.name: Problem
teile.suche: Qlib data preparation, clean market data
teile.text: Preparing clean, aligned market data takes hours, and errors often slip through unnoticed, costing research time.
teile.szene: Close‑up of a screen showing mismatched timestamps, the researcher frowns as warning icons flash, office lights dim to amber.

teile.name: Tool Intro
teile.suche: RD‑Agent signal scan, quant factor ranking
teile.text: RD‑Agent scans hundreds of market signals, ranks them, and outputs ready‑to‑test factors directly compatible with Qlib.
teile.szene: Animated flowchart visualizes dozens of signal icons funneling into a glowing list, presenter points with a stylized pointer, bright studio lighting.

teile.name: Step
teile.suche: Qlib backtest tutorial, import factors Qlib
teile.text: Import the generated factors into Qlib, then run a back‑test using its simulator for validation.
teile.szene: The researcher drags a CSV into a Qlib console, hits enter, and a performance chart springs up on a large monitor, daylight streaming in.
teile.geraeusch: command line click, chart rise chime

teile.name: Limitation
teile.suche: RD‑Agent Linux only, artifact loading trusted
teile.text: RD‑Agent runs only on Linux and requires loading trust for saved models, limiting Windows users.
teile.szene: A split‑screen shows a Linux terminal humming smoothly while a Windows desktop displays a warning sign, muted colors convey restriction.

teile.name: Payoff
teile.suche: RD‑Agent single command, quick factor generation
teile.text: With a command you receive factors, cut preparation time and can focus on strategy refinement.
teile.szene: The presenter smiles as a single terminal command flashes, then a tidy list of factors appears, sunrise light fills the room, conveying optimism.

teile.name: CTA
teile.text: Be sure to like, share and save this video.
teile.szene: Presenter points to a floating icon trio—thumbs up, share arrows, bookmark—against a darkened backdrop, neon outline pulses.
